description:

Word Reverser Using PrintWriter
40
Medium
Problem Statement
Read a line of text and print it reversed using a PrintWriter stream.
Description
Use BufferedReader to read a line of text, reverse its characters, and use a PrintWriter, wrapping System.out, to print the reversed string.
Input Description
A single line containing a string, str (no spaces).
Output Description
Print the reverse of str.
Sample Input
hello
Sample Output
olleh
